description: Work out a payment, delivery or legal deadline in business days for a given country. Lists a year's public holidays for 200+ countries and their regions, checks whether a date is a business day, adds or subtracts N business days, or counts business days between two dates, with configurable weekend days. Use when a due date or notice period depends on local public holidays. $0.002 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

add.description: Business days to add (negative to subtract)

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD to count business days between

year.description: Year to list all public holidays

name: business_days
